title: Bounded pre-simulation configurations
statement: For a Boolean string $y$ and a configuration $a$ consisting of a state, two work-tape head positions, and an output, $G(y,a)$ holds precisely when $	ext{PreS}(A,y,a)$ holds and each head position is at most $2(|y|+1)$.
caveat: The snippet does not define the predicate $	ext{PreS}$ or the parameter $A$, so their meanings cannot be specified further.
